fields.proactivePushHint: Allow the assistant to proactively push task-complete / error / input-required events back to this conversation. Off by default.

quietHours.help: When enabled, outbound traffic on this conversation defers during this window. Overrides the adapter-level quiet hours.

fields.workflowBindingHelp: When set (and no team is bound — a team wins), inbound messages run this Visual Workflow instead of a single character; the message text is the trigger payload and progress streams back to the conversation.
